Material response.
Human possibility.

DesertSkin-X explores a passively responsive bilayer membrane for humidity management. Monitoring is a separate, powered system. This dashboard presents a fixed synthetic demo, not live sensor readings.

Up to 20% lower water use and 30% less condensate are development targets. They are not validated outcomes or the source of the dashboard’s KPIs.
